selected_scope.finding: S1.42AH remains the active runtime candidate from exact accepted S1.42AF. The reverse-direction Pikmin -> MouthDog attack/death/cleanup path and adapter-side bite-protection behavior remain insufficiently evidenced, so S1.42AH is neither accepted nor rejected.
